subject: Request: pilot soft-landing while PO processes
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@aureonhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Lee <tim.lee@aureonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in finance

Hi Mina,

Quick note from our side — the pilot environment is starting to time out for a couple of key teams. Our procurement team flagged the purchase order as "pending additional review" and said it may not clear until next week (earliest: Nov 15).

We really want to keep momentum with the clinical team; losing the sandbox now would mean reorienting demo schedules and would delay our evaluation by several weeks. Is there any way Redwood can provide a short runway (token top-up or brief extension) while our PO clears? We’re not asking for a long-term concession — just enough capacity to finish the final integration tests and a couple of clinician sessions.

I attached the intent paperwork our finance manager sent over earlier. Happy to provide any additional details.

Best,
Samantha Green
Program Lead, Clinical AI
Aureon Health
[Attachment: Aureon_PO_Intent.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@aureonhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pilot is at risk — PO stuck in finance

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the intent doc. Really appreciate the visibility here.

We want to make sure you don’t lose momentum. I can approve a short, conditional "soft-landing" for the pilot while your PO is in flight. Proposal: 10 calendar days of continued sandbox access plus a one-time 40,000 token top-up (provisioned immediately). This is a one-off bridge; once the PO processes we’ll reconcile and convert to normal billing.

Two quick asks so I can get the internal approval routed:
- Confirm the expected PO clearance date (you mentioned Nov 15 — please confirm).
- Share the billing contact and any legal reviewer so we can attach the concession to the deal paperwork.

I’ve cc’d Aditya to coordinate the provisioning and Priya for handoff to CS once the PO is in. I’ll log the change on the HubSpot deal and attach the provisional note.

If that works, I’ll get the provisioning queued tonight and send a short confirmation note you can share with finance.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Mina — I’ll take care of provisioning the bridge tonight.

Samantha — we’ll push a 7-day top-up tonight to ensure the clinicians can complete the remaining sessions. This is a one-time provisional credit tied to DEAL-8742 and requires a PO or invoice conversion once your finance team clears the order. Expect an email confirmation from operations when it’s live.

Could you confirm the billing email we should attach the invoice to (someone at finance@aureonhealth.com or a different alias)? Also, if you can share the legal reviewer’s name / email I’ll note it for the paper trail.

— Aditya
